title: Tengu orchestrator plan
description: Discriminated union over direct-response vs multi-step plan. The harness validates every planner LLM output against this schema.

response.description: The text to show the user directly.

id.description: Plan-local identifier referenced by later steps' depends_on.

agent.description: Exact agent name from the ranked RAG roster.

depends_on.description: Step ids whose completed_outputs this step will consume.

compose.description: Phase 6.7 (C→B B-half) — optional. When present, the runner loads agents/<base_agent>.toml as the spec then OVERRIDES skills+tools with these values for THIS run only. Use ONLY after a prior turn asked the user to confirm a generic-agent fallback (REDESIGN §11). For normal routing, leave out.

base_agent.description: Exact agent name to load from agents/<name>.toml as the base spec — typically the closest-matching agent from the RAG roster.

skills.description: Skill names to attach for this run. Replaces the base spec's skills list. Each must be a real skill the three-tier scanner can find.

tools.description: Tool names to attach for this run. Replaces the base spec's tools list. Each must be a real registered tool.
